title: Amazon ECS Express Mode service with AWS CDK
description: Deploy a containerized web app on Amazon ECS Express Mode, which replaces AWS App Runner for new customers.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a containerized Node.js web application on Amazon ECS Express Mode with the AWS CDK. You give Express Mode a container image and two IAM roles, and it creates a Fargate service, an internet-facing Application Load Balancer with HTTPS, auto scaling, logging and a URL for the service.
AWS App Runner is closed to new customers, and AWS recommends Amazon ECS Express Mode as the replacement.

The CDK app builds the image from local source with DockerImageAsset during cdk deploy, so you don't push an image to Amazon ECR first. The stack uses the AWS::ECS::ExpressGatewayService resource (CfnExpressGatewayService) and passes an environment variable to the container.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
